_comment: Values of the NEW enum soupbroker.finance.LedgerAccountType (does not exist in soupmarkets-web yet). Persisted on LedgerAccount.accountType (nullable). singleton=true means at most one account per tenant may carry the value. requiredFor lists the business types whose template must contain it.

accountTypes.name: CASH
accountTypes.usedBy: Cash sales and petty-cash payments

accountTypes.name: BANK
accountTypes.usedBy: Default deposit target for receipts and source for payments

accountTypes.name: UNDEPOSITED_FUNDS
accountTypes.usedBy: Customer payments received but not yet banked

accountTypes.name: ACCOUNTS_RECEIVABLE
accountTypes.usedBy: Invoice posting (debit); wired to Account.defaultReceivableAccount

accountTypes.name: ACCOUNTS_PAYABLE
accountTypes.usedBy: Bill posting (credit); wired to Account.defaultPayableAccount

accountTypes.name: INVENTORY_ASSET
accountTypes.usedBy: Stock purchases and cost of goods sold relief

accountTypes.name: TAX_PAYABLE
accountTypes.usedBy: Output tax on invoices (one per tax, e.g. VAT, NHIL, GETFund)

accountTypes.name: TAX_RECEIVABLE
accountTypes.usedBy: Recoverable input tax on bills

accountTypes.name: WITHHOLDING_TAX_PAYABLE
accountTypes.usedBy: Tax withheld from supplier payments

accountTypes.name: WITHHOLDING_TAX_RECEIVABLE
accountTypes.usedBy: Tax customers withheld from our receipts (WHT credit)

accountTypes.name: INCOME_TAX_PAYABLE
accountTypes.usedBy: Corporate income tax provision

accountTypes.name: UNEARNED_REVENUE
accountTypes.usedBy: Customer deposits and payments received before an invoice

accountTypes.name: OPENING_BALANCE_EQUITY
accountTypes.usedBy: Counter-entry for opening balances during setup

accountTypes.name: RETAINED_EARNINGS
accountTypes.usedBy: Year-end close target

accountTypes.name: CURRENT_YEAR_EARNINGS
accountTypes.usedBy: Balance-sheet line for profit since the last close

accountTypes.name: SALES_INCOME
accountTypes.usedBy: Default income account for invoice lines with no mapped service description

accountTypes.name: DISCOUNTS_GIVEN
accountTypes.usedBy: Invoice discounts (contra income)

accountTypes.name: DISCOUNTS_RECEIVED
accountTypes.usedBy: Supplier discounts on bills

accountTypes.name: COST_OF_GOODS_SOLD
accountTypes.usedBy: Cost relief when inventory is sold

accountTypes.name: DEFAULT_EXPENSE
accountTypes.usedBy: Default expense account for bill lines with no mapped service description

accountTypes.name: FX_GAIN_LOSS
accountTypes.usedBy: Realised and unrealised exchange differences (SOUPFIN-125)

accountTypes.name: ROUNDING
accountTypes.usedBy: Rounding differences on invoices, bills and payments
